notes: The append-only attempt ledger is data/reference/accommodation_quote_attempts/copenhagen-shoulder-2026-07-24.jsonl. It records ten primary properties in frozen rank order: five accepted public quotes, one no-availability result, and four booking-path failures. Default-date, nightly-only, or mandatory-charge-unverifiable prices were not accepted. The materializer retains the five-quote shoulder median as incomplete seasonal evidence and publishes no accommodation tier until low, shoulder, and high all pass the sample and overlap gates.
